scope: Exploratory fixed-score controls; eight offsets within seed, then five seed mean/SD; not a newly held-out test.

protocol.protocol: All 180 fixed Pair R/RG CTC views, five seeds, native and all eight offsets; remove continuity only, alpha=0, original beta/candidates/scores. BC(0/1/2), CT, TRA, DET, LNK. Exploratory descriptive reporting; no model or threshold selection.

aggregation: Offsets averaged within seed; then mean and sample SD across seeds 1–5. Historical and follow-up predictions use the same CTC views and GT. BC tolerance is in observed frames.
